intro: In Booty Bay, a mercenary named Tokal is seeking a drink in exchange for the truth behind recent attacks on human and dwarven outposts. While rumors point the finger at the Horde, Tokal insists her group was operating under a private mercenary contract.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.
The rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.
I'll tell you the whole story if you buy me some grog.
